newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia, Australia in joint military exercise.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, Australia in joint military exercise.

text.p: Indonesia and Australia began a joint army and air force exercise on Wednesday involving about 145 soldiers and 123 air force personnel from the two countries, the official Antara news agency reported.
"This exercise is to further improve the friendship of our countries," the director of the joint operation, Indonesian air force brigadier-general Chappy Hakim was quoted as saying.
The routine exercise is being staged in Indonesia a day ahead of the third Indonesian-Australian ministerial forum to discuss ways to improve economic and trade ties between the two neighbours.
